text_block_list.text: I happen to spot Narita Taishin and am about to call out to her when she stops me with a deadly glare.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Halt! Don't you dare come any closer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I can't deal with noisy dimwits like you or Ticket right now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: My head'll split apart if you screech at me like you always do!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: One step closer… and I'll seriously punt you into space.
choice_data_list: Should we cancel training today, then?
Should we cancel training today, then?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: As if! I'll be fine once I rest for a bi—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: I really think you should rest.
I really think you should rest.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, fine! I'll go to the infirmary! You happy now?!
She looks at me with the desperation of a wounded beast as she stalks off.
